newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Feb first 10 days trade surplus falls 56.1%.
newsitem.headline: Japan Feb first 10 days trade surplus falls 56.1%.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus fell 56.1 percent to 83.18 billion yen in the first 10 days of February from a revised surplus of 189.31 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Wednesday.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports fell 5.6 percent from a year earlier to 1.16 trillion yen while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 3.6 percent to 1.07 trillion yen.
